title: Beacon incident operations console
audience: On-call engineers coordinating an active service incident
scenario: Beacon displays a static snapshot of a degraded API incident and its response timeline.
task: Build a high-density operations console that prioritizes incident status, ownership, affected services, and the next response action.

sections: Operations navigation with Incidents, Services, On-call, Runbooks, and Search
Incident header with SEV-2, Investigating, started 14:07 UTC, and commander Priya N.
Current impact: checkout API p95 latency above 2.4 s in us-east
Affected services list for Checkout API, Payments Worker, and Edge Gateway
Responders list with incident commander, communications lead, and investigator
Next update due 14:40 UTC and linked Runbook RB-17

requirements: Place severity, status, impact, and next update before supporting detail in document order
Use time elements or equivalent machine-readable timestamps
Do not rely on color alone for severity or service health
Represent the incident timeline as an ordered sequence
Expose controls as static or disabled when behavior is not implemented
constraints: Do not implement acknowledgement, escalation, messaging, or status changes
Do not auto-refresh or fetch data
Do not add fictional incident facts beyond the supplied snapshot
Do not use remote icons, fonts, or assets
evaluation_focus: Unambiguous state, ownership, and time semantics
